headline: Binance's assets keep falling as it waits to publish Tuesday's proof of reserves, while the hacker's funds keep moving and bitcoin holds near $78K before the US midterms.

market.asOf: Live price feeds could not be read this run; BTC and ETH from a Reuters report at 04:45 ET (16:45 Bangkok) Mon 2 Nov, via MarketScreener. Use the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 37 (Fear), up from 34 yesterday, on the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index, per CoinGabbar; KuCoin also reports 37 but gives the previous value as 30

stories.title: Binance's assets keep falling while it waits on Tuesday's proof of reserves
stories.summary: Binance reopened withdrawals on 1 Nov after the record hack. Its own figures show a $3.64B net outflow in the first hours, and outside trackers show a larger drop in total assets. The full proof of reserves (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) is due Tuesday 3 Nov (UTC).
points: From 06:00 to 15:30 UTC on 1 Nov, Binance processed $4.649B in withdrawals and $1.01B in deposits: $3.64B net, about 2.1% of its $171B in assets, per Unchained.
Binance says about 95% of the loss is now covered, up from 90% on 31 Oct, with ten assets including BTC, ETH, SOL, USDT and USDC fully backed, per Unchained.

DefiLlama shows Binance's tracked assets fell from about $144.9B on 29 Oct to about $128.3B early 2 Nov, a figure that also includes falling prices, per Bitcoin.com. Rivals gained: OKX about $450M net and Bybit about $134M, per Decrypt.
The hack size differs by source: about $6.3B by Binance's estimate per Unchained, $6.36B per The Daily Hodl.
Only 15 networks and assets reopened in phase 1, with no date for phase 2. The full proof needs 40 to 50 hours of computing, so it is due Tuesday, per Bitcoin.com.

stories.title: Stolen funds keep moving as the FBI presses THORChain
stories.summary: The FBI blames North Korea for the Binance hack. Stolen XRP moved early Monday, and money is leaving Tron through swap and bridge services. The FBI has asked THORChain node operators to block the hacker's addresses.
points: Bitcoin.com says all 233.46M stolen XRP (about $293M) moved to six new wallets between 03:52 and 04:00 UTC; Whale Alert data cited by BigGo shows only 80M XRP (about $100.9M) moving.

About $242M was laundered through Tron in two days and about $194M left via bridges and swaps; the largest exits were Relay ($48M), THORChain ($44M), Chainflip ($32.1M) and Symbiosis ($16M), per CryptoTicker. Chainalysis puts Tron flows above $500M, per Decrypt.
THORChain co-founder Chad Barraford did not commit to blocking the FBI's listed addresses, per CoinCentral.
Elliptic says $2.85B, about 44% of the theft, has been frozen or seized, per CryptoTicker.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $78K before Tuesday's midterms after a $643M ETF outflow
stories.summary: Reuters had bitcoin up 0.5% at $78,184 and ether up 1.5% at $2,296.44 at 04:45 ET Monday. US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $643M on Friday. Traders face Tuesday's US midterm elections and Friday's jobs report.
points: The dollar fell to a one-month low ahead of the midterms, per Reuters via MarketScreener.
Spot bitcoin ETFs lost $643.2M on Friday, with IBIT down $233.7M, leaving October about $516M negative, per Blockonomi.
Prediction markets Kalshi and Polymarket gave Democrats about 92-94% odds for the House and about 69% for the Senate as of 30 Oct, per CryptoTicker.
The CLARITY Act (crypto market-structure bill) failed a Senate procedural vote 49-50 on 15 Sep, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: THORChain halts most chains after an Ethereum reorg
briefs.summary: A separate Ethereum reorg halted 10 of THORChain's 13 chains; BTC, ETH and SOL were still halted and RUNE fell 18.4% to $0.507, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: BTCPay Server tells users to switch off servers
briefs.summary: Founder Nicolas Dorier says thefts appear to involve releases older than 2.4.2; there is no fix and no loss total yet, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Saylor hints at another Strategy buy
briefs.summary: Saylor posted "We found room for even more orange" on Sunday; Strategy held 848,517 BTC as of 25 Oct. No new purchase had been announced as of this update.

briefs.title: Coinbase adds its 18,000th bitcoin
briefs.summary: Brian Armstrong said Coinbase added its 18,000th BTC to its treasury, in a 2 Nov post wishing bitcoin a happy 18th birthday.

briefs.title: Hacker's bitcoin stash tops Coinbase's
briefs.summary: Bitquery traced 18,270 BTC to the attacker, more than Coinbase's 18,071 BTC as of 30 Sep, plus 508,621 ETH, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Spot ether ETFs see outflows too
briefs.summary: About $156M left spot ETH ETFs, per KuCoin's daily market report.

briefs.title: OnePay accepts USDC deposits
briefs.summary: OnePay and Stripe launched USDC deposits with direct USDC-to-dollar conversion across 12 blockchains, per KuCoin.

briefs.title: Lighter jumps on US licence plans
briefs.summary: Lighter's LIT token rose about 12% on plans to apply for US CFTC derivatives licences, per KuCoin.
